propositions: Eval harnesses hard-code corpus paths as CWD-relative `docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/replay` and `DEFAULT_LEDGER_PATH`, preventing client projects from using custom corpus locations with their own criteria routing.
The `plan_replay` and `provider_parity` modules lack a unified, configurable corpus root that respects CLI > env var > file > default precedence, blocking client adoption of the eval framework.

The `genai_prices` dependency is imported unconditionally in `ledger.py:120` but is declared as part of an `evals` extra missing from `src/rebar/_optional.py`, causing import failures when the extra is not installed.
The `provider_parity.py` spec discovery globs only packaged specs from `files()`, ignoring client-provided `.eval.yaml` files in a corpus root, so custom client specs never execute.
Five ledger functions in `ledger.py`, `tier1.py`, and `tier2.py` use a string default parameter for ledger path instead of `None`, making it impossible to override or apply per-invocation defaults.
The eval harnesses lack `--ledger` CLI flag and configurable output directory defaults, requiring clients to patch internal code rather than configure externally.
